_doc: Revert-verify mutants for the WIRING of req 8a0ed10b in ExoQLQueryExecutor (RFC 14217015 P1.4): the default-on toggle and the root-store cache key. Same harness as the decorator spec. `tree`/`subject` are placeholders (§A145).
subject: <ABSOLUTE PATH TO YOUR exocortex CHECKOUT>/packages/core/src/infrastructure/sparql/executors/QueryExecutor.ts

W1_resolution_off_by_default._note: The executor no longer wraps the store by default (the WIRING half of the feature): every SPARQL axis reddens; SP16, which drives the decorator directly, stays green — the decorator is fine, nobody calls it.

W2_index_keyed_per_executor._note: The property index is keyed on the per-executor class decorator instead of the root store, so every executor (PreconditionEvaluator makes one per evaluation) rebuilds it.
